# apple_retention_offer (Resource)

Defines a retention offer: a discount for an auto-renewable subscription that can be shown with the subscription's retention message when people start to cancel. Creating an offer doesn't present it; `apple_subscription_retention_message_offer` does. The offer's identity, terms and prices can't change, so changing them replaces the offer; the eligibility rules change in place. A subscription can have 10 retention offers per plan type. Destroying the resource deletes the offer. Import it by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "apple_subscription_price_points" "monthly" {
  subscription_id = apple_subscription.monthly.id
}

locals {
  monthly_points = { for p in data.apple_subscription_price_points.monthly.price_points : "${p.territory}-${p.customer_price}" => p.id }
}

resource "apple_retention_offer" "stay" {
  subscription_id            = apple_subscription.monthly.id
  reference_name             = "Stay one month"
  offer_id                   = "stay_one_month"
  offer_mode                 = "PAY_UP_FRONT"
  duration                   = "ONE_MONTH"
  period_count               = 1
  price_point_ids            = [local.monthly_points["USA-2.99"], local.monthly_points["GBR-2.49"]]
  paid_subscription_months   = 3
  wait_between_offers_months = 6
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `duration` (String) Length of each offer period: `THREE_DAYS`, `ONE_WEEK`, `TWO_WEEKS`, `ONE_MONTH`, `TWO_MONTHS`, `THREE_MONTHS`, `SIX_MONTHS`, `ONE_YEAR`.
- `offer_id` (String) Identifier of the offer in StoreKit, e.g. `stay_one_month`.
- `offer_mode` (String) Kind of offer: `FREE_TRIAL`, `PAY_AS_YOU_GO` (a discounted price each period) or `PAY_UP_FRONT` (one discounted price for all periods).
- `paid_subscription_months` (Number) Months a customer must have paid for the subscription to be eligible: 1 to 24, 36, 48 or 60.
- `period_count` (Number) Number of offer periods.
- `reference_name` (String) Reference name of the offer.
- `subscription_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the subscription, e.g. `apple_subscription.example.id`.

### Optional

- `plan_type` (String) Plan the offer is for: `UPFRONT` for the whole period at once, `MONTHLY` for a yearly plan billed monthly. Defaults to `UPFRONT`.
- `price_point_ids` (Set of String) Subscription price points of a paid offer, one per territory; see `data.apple_subscription_price_points`. A price point sets the price in its own territory. A free trial has none.
- `wait_between_offers_months` (Number) Months a customer waits after redeeming a retention offer for the subscription before another, from 2 to 24.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the retention offer.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = apple_retention_offer.stay
  identity = {
    id = "7710428835"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the retention offer.

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import apple_retention_offer.stay 7710428835
```
